body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in Batalha, Portugal. The listing gives its length as 1 hours, over a route of about 2 km. It starts at Batalha Monastery, Largo Infante Dom Henrique, 2440-109 Batalha, Portugal. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to Batalha Monastery. The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Delve into the enchanting town of Batalha with a ticket to the Batalha Monastery included - the pinnacle of Gothic architecture in Portugal. Ideal for history buffs and architecture enthusiasts, this self-guided audio tour is a gateway to the past, brought to life through the convenience of your device.
>
> Embark on a journey beginning at Batalha Monastery, exploring its splendor, the powerful statue of Nuno Álvares Pereira and the Founder’s Chapel's royal tombs. The route then guides you to the 'Unfinished Chapels' and the Museum of Batalha without leaving the monastery's vicinity. Wander through the town alongside other significant historical sites such as the Pillory of Batalha and the Church of the Holy Cross, before finally arriving at the Boutaca Bridge, a symbol of the town's medieval fortitude. The tour is eloquently structured, offering a cohesive narrative from start to finish.
>
> Travelers will gain a profound sense of the town’s heritage, visually experiencing the relentless passage of time and the human spirit's enduring legacy. Immerse yourself in Batalha's most remarkable aspects while gaining insights into each site's significance.
